Container.Name: OpenHabits
Container.Overview: A self-hosted habit tracker built around Atomic Habits. This is the server: it keeps the OpenHabits apps for iPhone, iPad, Mac, Windows and Linux in sync. After it starts, open the web page to create your account. Beta.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Accounts, habits and the server's keys. Back this folder up.

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: The app and the setup page, on your home network.

Config.Name: Remote access port
Config.Description: Secure connection for using the app away from home.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: For the calendar feed, e.g. Europe/London.

Config.Name: Reverse proxy address
Config.Description: Only if you reach this server through your own domain, e.g. https://habits.example.com.

Config.Name: Trust proxy
Config.Description: true behind a reverse proxy on your network; cloudflare for a Cloudflare tunnel.
